description.value: Hongdae Korean Restaurant is a Korean eatery in Coquitlam specializing in jokbal (braised pig's trotters), advertised as freshly prepared daily. Located at the intersection of North Road and Lougheed Highway, it offers indoor seating and online ordering. The late closing time makes it a viable stop for cyclists finishing a long evening ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and confirms the business name, address (#101-403 North Rd. Coquitlam, BC), and phone number (604) 492-1211 not present in OSM. The homepage prominently features 'Order Online' multiple times, confirming takeout service. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists (604) 492-1211 — phone added from website source.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Korean restaurant with a functioning website and confirmed address. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal or takeout in Coquitlam.
